purpose: Teach: 容積/相乗/喝采/セレクション/省エネルギー/真っ最中/ダントツ/授賞

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 保管容積を最適化しましょう
lines.style: Brisk, decisive. Snaps the opening phrase like it's the start of a meeting agenda. Clear enunciation, forward momentum. No softness.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。広告との相乗効果を計算します
lines.en: Yes. I'll calculate the synergy with our advertising.
lines.style: Efficient, attentive. Short nod in the voice. Takes the baton without hesitation. Steady, professional pace—no embellishment.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 喝采を浴びる新サービスを開発しましょう
lines.en: Let's develop a new service that gets real traction.
lines.style: Leadership tone, slight lift on the proposal. Confident without being loud. Expects agreement. Measured pace with a finish line in sight.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。代表選手のセレクション方法を整理します
lines.en: Yes. I'll organize how we select our team leads.
lines.style: Affirming, methodical. Brief pause after 'Yes'—absorbing the task. Speaks with the quiet competence of someone taking notes. No rush.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 省エネルギー対策を全社で進めましょう
lines.en: Let's drive an energy-efficiency initiative across the whole company.
lines.style: Clear directive, slightly expansive. Opens with resolve. Envisions scope. Steady, authoritative—not aggressive, just certain.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。プロジェクトは真っ最中で忙しいですが頑張ります
lines.en: Yes. The project's in full swing and we're busy, but we'll make it happen.
lines.style: Earnest, a touch strained underneath. Nods affirmation but lets honesty slip in—acknowledges the weight. Still committed. Slight breath before 'busy'.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 業界ダントツのシェアを目指しましょう
lines.en: Let's aim to dominate our industry's market share.
lines.style: Ambitious, commanding. Slight emphasis on 'dominate.' Opens with vision. Confident arc across the phrase. Expects this lands.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社内授賞式の演出を考えます
lines.en: Yes. I'll work out the staging for the company awards ceremony.
lines.style: Affirmative close. Settles into the final note—this is the last task. Thoughtful, not rushed. Lets the phrase breathe at the end.
